# YesChat.ai

> > YesChat.ai is a unified AI platform offering free access to cutting-edge models (GPT-4o, Claude, DeepSeek-R1) alongside generative tools for music, video, and image creation.

YesChat.ai aggregates multiple AI capabilities in one platform, enabling users to access premium AI models and creative generation tools without requiring ChatGPT Plus or other paid subscriptions. The platform combines chat assistants, GPT directories, and specialized creative tools like Suno AI music generation and Luma AI video creation.

## Core Platform & Models

- [YesChat.ai: Cutting-Edge AI Models for Chat, Music, and Video](https://yes.finechat.ai): YesChat.ai homepage featuring AI chat, music, video, and image generation with DeepSeek-R1, GPT-4o, Claude models
- [Use All GPTs for free at YesChat](https://yes.finechat.ai/gpts): Free access to 100,000+ GPTs including ResearchGPT, Write For Me, and Grimoire without ChatGPT Plus
- [YesChat Chat Assistants](https://yes.finechat.ai/app/chat/assistants): Directory of chat assistants including ResearchGPT, Write For Me, Grimoire, and AI PDF

## Creative Generation Tools

- [Free SUNO AI Music Generator](https://yes.finechat.ai/ai-music-generator): Free AI music generator powered by Suno V3.5 for creating songs with vocals and lyrics
- [Luma AI Video Generator: Transform Your Ideas into Videos Free Online](https://yes.finechat.ai/video-generator-l): Luma AI video generator using Dream Machine technology for text-to-video and image-to-video creation
- [Free Edit Text in Image Tool by yeschat.ai – AI-Powered & No Login](https://yes.finechat.ai/features/edit-text-in-image): Free AI tool to edit, remove, or add text in images without login or design skills
- [Free Background Remover by YesChat | AI-Powered Photo Background Eraser Online](https://yes.finechat.ai/features/background-remover): Free AI background remover for erasing photo backgrounds with batch processing support
- [Free AI Baby Face Generator by YesChat.ai: Create Your Future Baby's Face](https://yes.finechat.ai/features/baby-face-generator): Free AI generator creating realistic baby faces from uploaded photos of two people
